rationale: The workflow already implements several evidence-supported optimizations: concurrency cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE via cancel-in-progress: true), ccache for compilation caching, and vcpkg for dependency management. The remaining applicable patterns have contraindications that apply to this workflow: P-LIT-FAIL-FAST contraindicates when 'Every matrix outcome is required' — the matrix jobs test distinct PostgreSQL versions (14, 18) and sanitizers (ASan, TSan) where all outcomes are needed for compatibility coverage. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires 'Representative successful-duration history exists' per job, but only aggregate run history is available without per-job timing breakdown, risking false timeout failures. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE targets package-manager dependency downloads (Go, npm, pip) and does not directly apply to vcpkg/C++ builds. No other pattern matches the technology stack and constraints without contraindications.
